d: Long, wavy strawberry-blonde hair with side-swept bangs and a youthful, mature face paired with sharp, amethyst-purple eyes. A slender, athletic build wearing a tight, glossy black latex bodysuit with a high collar, topped with a voluminous black and white hooded cloak that drapes over the shoulders. The outfit is accessorized with a black utility belt featuring orange ammunition cartridges, a black forearm guard on one arm, and sleek black high heels. A large, futuristic white and grey mechanical weapon case is carried by a strap over the shoulder, while a black and gold rifle is held in one hand.
